facts.claim: 罗斯说她清晨去庭院开喷泉时看见了德尔德丽并报了警。
facts.quote: I saw her there and called the police.

facts.claim: 罗斯承认昨晚没检查通往外面停车处的门是否锁上，而她平时都会检查。
facts.quote: I didn’t check that the door was locked last night

facts.claim: 阿比坚称自己锁了门，因此断定有人把德尔德丽放了进来。
facts.quote: That means someone had to let her in.

facts.claim: 阿比清点钥匙：罗斯有一把，吉纳维芙和丹各有一把，加上吉纳维芙给她的备用钥匙。
facts.quote: Rose has one, of course. And Genevieve and Dan each have a copy.

facts.claim: 玛丽莲解释昨夜穿浴袍下楼是为取忘在钢琴上的乐谱，但叙述者注意到她手里并没有乐谱。
facts.quote: I was retrieving some music I’d forgotten on the piano.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙形容枯槁、拖着步子进餐厅，几乎提不起力气，阿比起身扶她入座。
facts.quote: she was shuffling as though she could barely summon the energy to move

facts.claim: 叙述者忽然想到：凶手的目标也许正是吉纳维芙本人，德尔德丽只是被利用的手段。
facts.quote: What if Genevieve Caraway were the true target?

facts.claim: 罗斯当众传话警探要问叙述者的话，她离席时阿比用口型对她说别跟摩门教徒乱来。

relations.rel: 最好的朋友（besties），阿比一心护着她
relations.quote: The dynamics between these two besties of Genevieve’s seemed cordial enough

relations.rel: 情侣/伴侣，塞缪尔包容健二的张扬
relations.quote: pointing an accusatory spoon at his boyfriend
She nodded at her husband in the same preoccupied way

relations.rel: 主仆之间互无好感（no love lost）
relations.quote: there was no love lost between Rose and Genevieve

relations.rel: 父女关系紧张，互无好感
母子（Caraway 一家三口之一）
relations.quote: the Caraways filed into the room, one by one

numbers.claim: 长餐桌原本可坐二十人
numbers.quote: long, narrow table that could have sat twenty
it was set for a mere eight
set for a mere eight, four to a side

numbers.claim: 叙述者八年级时去过华盛顿
罗斯可能有七条一样的连衣裙，一天一条
numbers.quote: she had seven of them, one for each day of the week

numbers.claim: Caraway 家三人中最先到的是丹
阿比在一两分钟后出现
numbers.quote: Abi Brooke made an appearance a minute or two later

numbers.claim: 叙述者又拿了两条培根
当时房里只有她们两人
numbers.quote: we were still the only two people in the room

numbers.claim: 罗斯倒完咖啡又多花几秒擦壶嘴
numbers.quote: she took a few extra seconds to rub the spout

numbers.claim: 健二称谋杀调查是绝佳的增碳借口
numbers.quote: a murder investigation is an A-plus one

numbers.claim: 健二用食指互搓示意有人要倒霉
numbers.quote: rubbing the top of one index finger

numbers.claim: 八把椅子全被家人或客人占满
numbers.quote: all eight chairs around this table were occupied

numbers.claim: 叙述者又添了一份薯饼
numbers.quote: a second helping of hash browns

turning_point: 叙述者在早餐桌上想通：凶手或许并非为护吉纳维芙而杀德尔德丽，而是故意留下指向吉纳维芙的疑点，真正的目标就是让她成为嫌疑人。
notes: 1) 叙述者姓名本章未出现，故 relations 只用有名字的人物。2) “the three”指 Caraway 一家三口（丹、塞斯、吉纳维芙），据上下文推断。3) 罗斯是否真没锁门、玛丽莲取乐谱的说法是否属实，本章均未证实。
